dirk_lib_discord_intro: Bot credentials used by lib.discord across every dirk_lib consumer. Leave blank to disable Discord-backed features (role lookups, member queries, etc.) — they'll surface a 'configure here' message instead of failing.
dirk_lib_discord_token_tooltip: Discord bot token. Server-side only — never sent to clients.
dirk_lib_discord_guild_tooltip: Discord server (guild) ID the bot operates against by default.
dirk_lib_discord_guide_step1_body: Sign in with the Discord account that owns the server you want the bot to operate in.
dirk_lib_discord_guide_step2_body: Click 'New Application', give it a name (this becomes the bot's display name), and confirm.
dirk_lib_discord_guide_step3_body: Open the 'Bot' tab → click 'Reset Token' → copy the token and paste it into the Bot Token field above. The token is shown only once.
dirk_lib_discord_guide_step4_body: Still on the Bot tab, scroll to 'Privileged Gateway Intents' and toggle 'Server Members Intent' on. Required for role / member lookups.
dirk_lib_discord_guide_step5_body: OAuth2 → URL Generator → tick 'bot' scope, leave permissions empty (read-only is fine), open the generated URL and add the bot to your server.
dirk_lib_discord_guide_step6_body: Enable Developer Mode in Discord (User Settings → Advanced), right-click your server icon → 'Copy Server ID' and paste into the Guild ID field above.
dirk_lib_logger_intro: External log backend used by lib.logger across every dirk_lib consumer. Credentials stay inside dirk_lib's server VM — they're never sent to consumers or clients. Set to Off to disable external logging (resources still fire their own Discord webhooks).
dirk_lib_logger_service_tooltip: Which external log sink lib.logger ships to. Off = no external logging.
dirk_lib_logger_hostname_tooltip: Optional hostname label attached to every log line. Defaults to sv_projectName when blank.
dirk_lib_logger_datadog_key_tooltip: Datadog API key (DD-API-KEY). Server-side only — never sent to clients.
dirk_lib_logger_datadog_site_tooltip: Datadog site, e.g. datadoghq.com, datadoghq.eu, us5.datadoghq.com.
dirk_lib_logger_loki_endpoint_tooltip: Loki base URL. https:// is assumed if no scheme is given; the push path is appended automatically.
dirk_lib_logger_loki_user_tooltip: Basic-auth username. Leave blank for an unauthenticated push endpoint.
dirk_lib_logger_loki_password_tooltip: Basic-auth password / API key. Server-side only — never sent to clients.
dirk_lib_logger_loki_tenant_tooltip: Optional X-Scope-OrgID tenant header for multi-tenant Loki.

Cannot be edited from the panel by design — if you lock yourself out via overrides, the convar is your escape hatch.

Legacy `dirk:logger` + per-backend convars still work as a fallback when service is 'off'/unset.

studio.home.title: Script Studio
studio.home.subtitle: Every dirk script's settings, in one place. Pick a script on the left to edit it, or use the pages below the rail for things that span all of them.
studio.home.note.save.title: Nothing saves until you press Save
studio.home.note.save.body: Edits are staged. The bar at the bottom counts them, Undo and Redo step through them, and Discard throws the lot away.
studio.home.note.overrides.title: Only what you changed is stored
studio.home.note.overrides.body: A setting you never touch keeps following the script's own default, so improvements that ship in an update actually reach this server. Change history shows who changed what, and lets you put it back.
studio.home.note.search.title: Search covers everything
studio.home.note.search.body: Names, descriptions, setting paths and list rows — across the whole script.
studio.home.note.serverOnly.title: Some settings never leave the server
studio.home.note.serverOnly.body: Tokens, webhooks and keys are marked SERVER ONLY. They are editable here and are never sent to players.
studio.home.note.invalid.title: Red means it will not save
studio.home.note.invalid.body: A setting outside its allowed range blocks saving and says why. Greyed-out settings are switched off by another setting, which is named on the row.
